_what: The door operations the Workshop's text may tell an AI to call: each method an owner behind the door answers. A call names only its method (do_one_thing_in_my_account {method, request_key, input}): the door finds the owner that declares it (trillion-rust D1, Workshop 47a6aeca8). `addressed` are the methods no owner declares, which a call still sends to an address. They come from the engine's own DATA (trillion-rust tool-runs.json `*_method`, wake.json, share-grant.json `door_grant.act` and the secrets operations; the same set its scopes are checked against, D3.1), and the door's own paged read of these instructions (`ai-instruction-settings.read` in rows.json). test-helpers/named-calls.mjs treats any other door call named in shipped text as one nothing answers. The person's own data is not behind the door: it is in the person's own stores, reached with their own connections. `addresses` are the ones a call may still carry, from before calls named only a method; the door ignores one on a method an owner declares, so text naming one is not a call nothing answers (it leaves as the text is reworded).
